about.title: Profile
about.description: Operational manager and digital project manager with 8+ years of experience.
about.texte:
Operational manager and digital project manager with over 8 years of experience in client relations, strategic support, and digital. Founder of a music marketing agency (500+ artists, 34M views). Startup co-founder with a Ledger co-creator. Expertise in digital marketing, automation, and artificial intelligence. Strong passion for tech and continuous improvement.

Key skills: digital project management, team coordination, change management, technology watch, digital mediation, digital tools deployment and team training.

Accredited photographer for Rolling Stone France and Forbes. International Photography Awards 2023 Winner. A cultural and artistic sensitivity that enriches my project vision.
about.highlight: Ready to bring my digital expertise and cultural passion to your organization.

tachfin.name: Tachfin Khelil
tachfin.title: General Manager - John Paul
tachfin.text: As site director at John Paul Lisbon, I had the pleasure of working with Denis ADAM, whose dedication, rigor, and versatility greatly contributed to the quality of our premium service. He structured and strengthened our night concierge team, while showing strong crisis management and customer experience skills. Proactive, resilient, and always solution-oriented, Denis earned the trust of clients and colleagues alike. I highly recommend him for any position requiring leadership, adaptability, and excellence in relationships.
